newsitem.title: USA: DOT June report of U.S. airline performance.
newsitem.headline: DOT June report of U.S. airline performance.

text.p: The Transportation Department Air Travel Consumer Report on the performance of the 10 largest U.S. air carriers in domestic non-stop flights.

The percent of on-time arrivals is based on reports from the 28 airports required to report by the DOT plus voluntary reports from other airports.
The consumer complaints portion of the report is based on complaints made to DOT in writing, by telephone or in person. DOT said it has not determined the validity of the complaints.
Total passenger complaints include flight delays, mishandled bags and oversales. They do not concern charges of safety violations, which are handled by the Federal Aviation Administration.
